name: get_questions
description: Get trivia questions from the Open Trivia Database. Optionally filter by category, difficulty, and question type.

amount.description: Number of questions to return. Defaults to 10. Max 50.

category.description: Category ID to filter by. Use list_categories to get available IDs.

difficulty.description: Difficulty level. One of: easy, medium, hard.

type.description: Question type. One of: multiple (multiple choice), boolean (true/false).

name: list_categories
description: List all available trivia categories and their IDs.

name: get_category_stats
description: Question inventory for one Open Trivia Database (opentdb.com) category, given the numeric category id from list_categories. Returns the total number of quiz questions in that category plus the easy, medium, and hard counts. Answers how many trivia questions the Open Trivia DB holds on a topic before requesting a quiz round of a given difficulty.

category.description: Category ID. Use list_categories to get available IDs.
